description: This file implements state handling logic for lifecycle management in a plugin-based framework, including states like loading, initializing, pausing, active, suspending, hibernating, and terminating. It interacts with runtime, window, and request handlers, and manages application context and lifecycle transitions.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Represents the unloaded state of an application, handling cleanup or transition logic.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Represents the loading state, responsible for initializing application instance ID and signaling readiness.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles application initialization, including starting runtime and setting pending events.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Manages the paused state, handling display and runtime suspension.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Represents the active running state, ensuring render readiness.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles suspension and resumption, including display disablement and wake-up.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Manages hibernation, involving runtime hibernate calls.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles application termination, including kill or terminate commands.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles state-specific logic for lifecycle transitions, returning success status.
